reason: 该插件的核心面向用户价值是为 DSH 的右侧技能侧边栏提供可直接使用的“技能”选项卡：汇总可读取的技能并展示简短功能短语，支持快速复制调用与自动刷新。证据来自 README 的注册侧边栏逻辑、会话/API 与本机扫描合并、缓存策略、文件监控与定时重扫设计，以及 package.json 的客户端注入与平台声明。

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DSH 的右侧边栏技能面板插件，用于集中展示本机与会话可见技能并提供简洁描述、快捷复制与自动更新能力。
summaries.en: This is a DSH web plugin that adds a side panel tab to list available skills, show concise descriptors, support quick copy-to-call actions, and keep the list refreshed automatically.

capabilities: Reads and merges skill metadata from local skill directories and session-provided skill listings
Injects a tab into the DSH better sidebar UI for quick skill browsing
Caches skill lists on server and in browser storage for fast rendering
Watches local filesystem changes and periodically refreshes skill data
Exposes plugin routes to return and force-refresh skill lists

reasons.code: README: the plugin registers a "Skills" tab in dsh-better-sidebar (right panel) and renders skills with compact, two-line entries.
README: skill list is built from real-time session API (`connection.api.skills.list`) and server scan of local skill roots (`~/.agents/skills`, `SKILL.md` parsing).
README: backend caches scan results, runs `/skillpanel/skills` and `/skillpanel/skills/refresh`, and refreshes on a timer plus change detection.
README/package.json: defines web plugin client injection and integration points for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` and `dsh-better-sidebar`.
